snippet.title: The Dark World of New Age Gurus | Documentary.
snippet.description:
New Age and Law of Attraction gurus have been on the rise since Rhonda Byrne released her 2006 film, The Secret.

But there is a sinister industry and reality that lies behind the teachings of New Thought which seemingly goes unnoticed.

► Part 1 of the series: https://youtu.be/OHz4slbIRyE

(Sources/Visuals - https://drive.google.com/file/d/13M239niG_eIq2WY7S-vy4j8_D9uxFLAu/view?usp=sharing)

******
►  Become a Patron for behind the scenes, Q&A's, and editing tutorials: https://www.patreon.com/jamesvj

💻Where I began Learning How to Edit + Other Clases (Skillshare)
► https://skillshare.eqcm.net/Kr3Yn

📦 Download my Video Editing Templates:
►  https://www.jamesjani.com/shop/

📹 My Equipment:
►https://bit.ly/2OfHCTO

🎶 Where I Get My Music:
►Epidemic Sounds - https://www.epidemicsound.com/referral/5uqnji

🔧 Helpful tool for YouTubers (TubeBuddy):
►  https://www.tubebuddy.com/Jamesvj

💼 Job Opportunities: 
► https://jamesjani.notion.site/James-Jani-Hiring-Hub-b669861daa0b4b3bbe60b6515aab418b

***
𝗟𝗘𝗧'𝗦 𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗖𝗧:
📸 IG: james.v.j // https://bit.ly/2TOaBBC
🐦 Twitter: @jamesvjani // https://bit.ly/2zYPrsT



******
Rhonda Byrne's Film, "The Secret" popularised the "Law of Attraction" greatly, and has allowed this philosophy/belief to permeate in the mainstream for a very long time. 

But the history that lies behind "The Secret" is one that has its roots all the way back to the 1800s, where the New Thought Movement began taking strides, as well as other New Age beliefs. 

In this video, we take a dive into that history, and the sinister industry that his been built up around it. We'll take a look at some of the most influential figures in New Thought throughout the past, to present day. Figures like Napoleon Hill (author of "Think and Grow Rich", and "The Law of Success"), Esther/Abraham Hicks (Author of "The Law of Attraction" and various other works), Bob Proctor, Rhonda Byrne, and others. 

We will also identify just how  New Age Spirituality has allowed itself to become a perfect grift, for gurus with questionable intentions to enter the space and take advantage of those in a more vulnerable and desperate situation. Those who are in desperate need of wealth, those who are in desperate need for relationships, health, happiness, etc etc. 

New Age/New Thought exists in many areas of the self-help industry too, and although hard to initially spot, once someone familiarises themselves with the teachings of New Thought and the overall philosophy it isn't hard to begin seeing the patterns. 

We will also explore the connections between New Age gurus and Multi Level Marketing companies. A connection that seems very prevalent within many of the big figures in this industry. 


******

Don’t worry – I only ever promote things that have genuinely helped me.

snippet.title: Religious Ponzi Schemes Exposed: How Affinity Fraud Exploits Faith
snippet.description:
"Give me $1,000, and God will give you $10,000." It sounds insane, but millions of people fall for it every year. This is the dark world of Affinity Fraud, where pastors turn into con artists and pews become hunting grounds. We investigate how Greater Ministries International and others used scripture to orchestrate billion-dollar Ponzi schemes.

Understand the psychology of "The Prosperity Gospel" and why smart people get brainwashed into giving away their life savings. It’s not just about greed; it’s about weaponizing faith against the faithful.

If you want to know about other ways your money is under attack, check out our guide on Cyber Fraud: https://youtu.be/k5gxF3keJoc

True faith shouldn't cost you your retirement. Learn to spot the wolves in sheep's clothing.

#ReligiousScam #FinancialFraud #FaithAndMoney #PonziScheme #GreaterMinistries

snippet.title: The Horny Loser Who Caused WW1

This week's video is about the Mayerling Affair, a story from an infamous hunting lodge in the Austrian countryside. It is a story about the first world war that I'd never heard before visiting and thus felt like it was worth passing on.

snippet.title: He Sold U.S. Military Secrets to the KGB for Just $54,000
snippet.description:
A missing 75 cents exposed one of the most shocking cyber espionage operations of the Cold War.

In the 1980s, German hacker Markus Hess infiltrated hundreds of military, government, and research computer systems across the United States, Europe, and Asia. Alongside fellow hackers, he stole sensitive information and allegedly sold it to the Soviet KGB for just $54,000.

What started as a tiny accounting error at a California laboratory soon uncovered an international spy network operating through some of the world's earliest computer networks. The investigation would become one of the first major cybercrime cases in history and forever change how governments viewed computer security.

This documentary explores:
• The rise of Markus Hess
• How Cold War hackers infiltrated military networks
• The KGB connection
• The famous 75-cent clue
• Clifford Stoll's groundbreaking investigation
• The birth of modern cybersecurity
• How this case predicted today's cyber warfare

Long before ransomware, nation-state hackers, and cyber espionage dominated headlines, Markus Hess showed the world that wars could be fought through computer networks.

If you enjoy documentaries about espionage, Cold War history, intelligence agencies, hacking, cybersecurity, and true stories, this is a case you won't want to miss.
